At Northwind Labs, Felistas leads the payments platform team. The team owns money movement between the product and partner banks, including the Ledgerline reconciliation engine.

The biggest change was moving settlement from a nightly batch to streaming, which made mismatches visible within minutes. Felistas also introduced service level objectives and on-call runbooks, so incidents are handled the same way whoever is on call.
